meta.name: Magneta — grant the breaker's pauser on the NEW Base Gateway
meta.description: Re-grant the circuit breaker's pauser role on the Base Gateway redeployed 2026-08-03 (0x6BBFbC488a93A19179b34aC3A57977C343eeA5c1). The key is registered on the RETIRED Gateway only, so since the cutover the breaker has been unable to act on Base — the redeploy silently removed a safety net rather than any single mistake doing it. Same key, same one-way capability: pause() is open to a pauser, unpause() is onlyOwner, and removePauser revokes at will. Run this on every chain right after its wave, before the site is cut over to it.
